caption: The drawing depicts an open rectangular wooden case with brass-colored handles on both the top and bottom sections. The inside of the case is shown to be divided into two sections, with the lid part containing a set of stacked, wooden frames or boards, and a piece of cloth—white with a lavender lace trim—folded and partially draped over one of the wooden sections. The base of the case contains a flat, grey-blue surface, bordered by the wood of the case, which may be a slate or some type of board. There is also a black-and-white outline drawing of a small, closed rectangular object (possibly a book or a pad) floating to the left of the case, separate from the main illustration. The drawing is labeled with the name "LLOYD CHARLES LEMCKE 1937" in small capital letters below the case. The background of the image is a plain off-white or cream color.
title: Pillow Sham Holder
